_method: Editorial 0-100 scores. longstay = ease for volunteers/new residents of many nationalities to live 1+ yr (volunteer, nomad, retiree/passive, low-bar temp residence, long tourist stays, bloc mobility). pr = path to PR/citizenship (years, tests, dual nationality). Verified via 2025-26 web sources (est:false); others est:true. prYears 0 = permanent-type status from start.

ESP.note: Golden visa ended Apr 2025. RD 1155/2024 cut arraigo to 2 yrs. Citizenship 10 yrs (2 for Latin Americans/Filipinos); dual nationality only for Ibero-American states.

CHE.note: Very restrictive for non-EU/EFTA. C permit 10 yrs (5 for some); citizenship 10 yrs with cantonal tests; dual allowed.

AUS.note: Investor retirement visa closed to new applicants; PR via skills/employer. Citizenship 4 yrs (1 as PR); dual allowed.

PRT.note: D7 is Europe's lowest passive-income bar. But 2025-26 tightening: job-seeker visa & manifestação de interesse abolished; citizenship now 10 yrs (7 CPLP/EU, law of May 2026); AIMA backlogs.

NZL.note: Visitors may now work remotely for overseas employers. New skilled pathways Aug 2026. Citizenship 5 yrs; dual allowed.

ITA.note: Consular ERV approvals strict (no work). DN visa since Apr 2024. EU long-term permit after 5 yrs; citizenship 10 yrs + B1; descent route curbed 2025.

JPN.note: Tightening: naturalisation residence raised to 10 yrs (Apr 2026); PR income/language rules and ¥200k fee from Oct 2026; DN visa not extendable. No dual.

DEU.note: No nomad/retiree visa. Settlement permit ~5 yrs. Citizenship 5 yrs with dual allowed (3-yr 'turbo' abolished Oct 2025). B1 German required.

AUT.note: Passive-income permit is quota-limited and needs ~€1,300+/mo plus housing. Citizenship 10 yrs, dual generally barred.

FRA.note: No DN visa. From 2026: A2 French for multi-year card, B1 for 10-yr card, B2 + civic exam for naturalisation. Citizenship 5 yrs; dual allowed.

DNK.note: Among Europe's strictest regimes. PR ~8 yrs with tests; citizenship 9 yrs; dual allowed.

routes: Digital nomad (up to 2 yrs since Jan 2026)
TWN.note: DN visa extended to 2 yrs (visa-exempt nationals). APRC after 5 yrs (Gold Card faster). Naturalisation normally requires renunciation.

NLD.note: Tight for most nationalities. Naturalisation 5 yrs but usually must renounce; a 10-yr proposal was consulted 2025, not law as of Aug 2026.

GBR.note: ILR still 5 yrs but 'earned settlement' (10-yr baseline) planned; rules not laid as of Sep 2026. Citizenship ILR+1 yr; dual allowed.

NOR.note: EEA via EFTA. PR after 3 yrs work (income test); citizenship 8 yrs; dual allowed since 2020.

USA.note: Travel bans on 39 countries (Jan 2026) and B visa bonds for ~50 nations. R-1 re-entry wait removed Jan 2026 but EB-4 green cards heavily backlogged.

KOR.note: Workation visa up to 2 yrs for high earners. F-5 PR ~5 yrs via points; citizenship 5 yrs, dual restricted.

CAN.note: 2026-28 plan cuts new temporary residents ~43% (to 385k) while PR stays 380k/yr. Citizenship 3 of 5 yrs; dual allowed.

BEL.note: Few routes for non-workers. Citizenship 5 yrs with integration/language proof; dual allowed.

HKG.note: PR after 7 yrs; no HK citizenship for non-Chinese. Civil-society space narrowed since 2020.

ISL.note: Tiny labour market; residence mostly via work/family. Citizenship 7 yrs; dual allowed.

SWE.note: Citizenship raised to 8 yrs with income, language and civics tests from 6 Jun 2026 (no grandfathering). Dual allowed.

GRC.note: Since 2026 DN permit needs a D visa from abroad. Golden visa €800k in Athens/islands, €400k elsewhere. Citizenship 7 yrs + Greek B1 and exam; dual allowed.

ISR.note: Kibbutz volunteering is the closest analogue, but stays are short and war-related disruption continues. Naturalisation for non-Jews rare.

FIN.note: PR after 4 yrs continuous; citizenship raised to 8 yrs (Oct 2024); dual allowed.

LUX.note: Very high costs; residence mostly via work. Citizenship 5 yrs + Luxembourgish test; dual allowed.

IRL.note: Not in Schengen. Stamp 0 is not reckonable for citizenship; Stamp 1/4 are. Naturalisation 5 yrs; dual allowed.

SMR.note: Tiny state; residence by investment/wealth or marriage. Naturalisation takes decades.

SYC.note: Residence very restricted; land purchase by foreigners needs sanction.

HRV.note: DN permit up to 18 months then 6-month exit before reapplying. Citizenship 8 yrs, normally must renounce.

POL.note: Company-based residence is common and affordable. PR 5 yrs; citizenship ~3 yrs after PR (proposals to lengthen); dual tolerated.

AND.note: Passive residence needs heavy investment + 90 days/yr presence. Citizenship 20 yrs, renunciation required.

CZE.note: Živno freelancer visa is a well-trodden route; DN scheme limited to some nationalities/high earners. PR 5 yrs; citizenship 5 yrs PR+; dual allowed.

CYP.note: Cat F visitor permit is accessible for retirees but slow. DN 1 yr + 2. Citizenship ~8 yrs (faster with Greek B1).

SVN.note: DN permit added late 2024 but cannot be renewed back-to-back. PR 5 yrs; citizenship 10 yrs, renunciation usually required.

BRB.note: Welcome Stamp renewable; small island, high costs. One of 4 CARICOM states with full free movement since Oct 2024.

routes: Premium Visa (1 yr renewable, foreign income)
MUS.note: Premium Visa open to most nationalities. Finance Act 2025: PR wait raised to 5 yrs; property duty on non-citizens 10% from Jul 2026.

SGP.note: Residence tied to work; PR discretionary; land prices prohibitive.

BHS.note: Remote-work permit accessible; long-term residence wealth-gated; hurricane exposure.

ATG.note: NDR is one of the longest Caribbean nomad permits; residence otherwise wealth-gated.

CRI.note: Stable democracy; PR after 3 yrs temporary; citizenship 7 yrs. DN status doesn't lead to PR. Investor bar may return to $200k.

ROU.note: DN threshold among EU's highest. PR 5 yrs; citizenship 8 yrs (5 if married); dual allowed.

MAC.note: Tiny, costly; residence via work/talent only.

routes: Legal residence with modest income proof
URY.note: Among the world's easiest residence systems; stable democracy. Citizenship 3 yrs (family) / 5 yrs; dual allowed. DN permit time not reckonable.

TTO.note: Energy economy; crime high; few non-work routes.

ARG.note: Decree 366/2025: health insurance for entrants, income proof for PR, citizenship 2 yrs with NO exits; PR lost after 1 yr abroad.

BRN.note: Sharia penal code; residence via employment only.

BGR.note: Low-cost EU state; full Schengen 2025, euro 2026. DN residence opened Dec 2025 (1 yr + 1). Citizenship ~5 yrs after PR; renunciation usually required.

EST.note: DN visa ≤1 yr, high bar. Immigration quota on work. Citizenship 8 yrs + Estonian; no dual for naturalised.

GRD.note: No formal nomad visa (sources conflict). CBI gives E-2 treaty access to US.

SVK.note: Business-based residence possible but bureaucratic. Citizenship 8 yrs; dual generally barred.

MYS.note: DE Rantau 12 + 12 mo. MM2H revamped 2024 (90 days/yr stay). PR rarely granted.

CHL.note: 2021 migration law requires applying from abroad (SERMIG online). PR after ~2 yrs; citizenship 5 yrs; dual allowed.

ARE.note: Easy renewable residence for many nationalities, but no PR or realistic citizenship; land use and association rules restrictive.

MLT.note: English-speaking but costly. Nomad permit renewable to 4 yrs. Golden passport struck down by EU court Apr 2025.

BRA.note: Naturalisation 4 yrs (1 with Brazilian spouse/child); dual allowed. eVisa reinstated for US/CAN/AUS 2025.

MDV.note: Islamic legal regime; residence only via employment; land not sold to foreigners.

MEX.note: Solvency now UMA-based and varies by consulate. PR after 4 yrs temporary; citizenship 5 yrs; dual allowed. Tourist days often cut at entry.

ECU.note: PR after 21 months temporary; citizenship 3 yrs; dual allowed. Criminal-record certificate needed for each visa since 2025. Security worsened 2024-26.

BTN.note: Tourism capped by SDF ($100/night); no residence routes for outsiders.

CUB.note: Economic crisis, blackouts; tight state control of associations.

THA.note: DTV opened long stays to nearly all nationalities (remote work/soft-power courses). Visa-exempt cut to 30 days from 15 Sep 2026. PR quota tiny; land ownership barred.

LTU.note: Business route possible. Citizenship 10 yrs; dual nationality generally barred (2024 referendum failed).

GEO.note: One-year visa-free stays remain the key draw. 2025-26 tightening: work permits for foreigners incl. self-employed, higher property bar, stricter student/marriage permits.

KNA.note: Residence otherwise via work; small and costly.

TUR.note: Tourist residence permits curtailed; renewals tougher since 2023. Long-term residence after 8 yrs; citizenship 5 yrs; dual allowed.

PER.note: DN visa legislated 2023 but still not operational (Jul 2026). Volunteer visa notoriously bureaucratic. PR after 3 yrs; dual allowed.

HUN.note: White Card does not count toward PR. Guest Investor gives 10+10-yr residence. Citizenship 8 yrs; dual allowed.

LCA.note: Nomad-type stays offered; long-term residence mostly via investment.

TON.note: Land cannot be sold to foreigners; small economy.

OMN.note: Residence mostly employer-sponsored; investor residence for the wealthy.

WSM.note: Customary land; residence via work, volunteering programmes or investment.

ARM.note: Residence permits surged in 2026. From 1 Nov 2026 an online-only system and work-permission rules tighten; fees rise 2027. Dual citizenship allowed.

SAU.note: Premium Residency for wealthy/skilled; religious practice and NGO activity restricted.

VCT.note: Small island; few long-stay routes for non-CARICOM nationals.

BHR.note: Golden residence accessible to retirees with ~BHD 2,000/mo or property. No PR/citizenship path in practice.

PLW.note: 'Digital residency' ID is not residence. COFA benefits only Palauans in US.

MCO.note: Wealth-gated residence only. Naturalisation discretionary (10 yrs adult), renunciation required.

DMA.note: Volcanic 'nature island', eco-tourism ethos; WIN visa 18 months. Hurricane risk.

LVA.note: Property-based residence is an option. Citizenship 10 yrs + Latvian; dual only with EU/NATO etc.

SUR.note: Dutch-speaking; residence permits obtainable but bureaucratic.

routes: Entry (X) visa w/ host letter (e.g. Auroville)
IND.note: Auroville residents need Foundation recommendation letters; 2024-26 renewal delays/denials. Immigration & Foreigners Act 2025 in force. No PR; citizenship 12 yrs, no dual; OCI only for Indian origin.

PAN.note: Pensionado gives indefinite residence. Friendly Nations now 2-yr provisional before PR. Investor reduced bar reportedly ends Oct 2026.

routes: Digital nomad V visa (~3x min wage ≈$1,300/mo)
COL.note: Online e-visa system; DN time doesn't count toward residence. R visa now needs 5-yearly transfer. Citizenship 5 yrs (2 for Latin Americans); dual allowed.

CHN.note: Foreign NGOs tightly controlled (2017 law); PR ('green card') rare; no dual citizenship.

VNM.note: Since Feb 2026 residence cards only for LD2/TT holders. Golden visa pilot under Res. 41/2026 capped at 8,000. PR/citizenship essentially closed.

LKA.note: New DN visa (12 mo, renewable) launched Feb 2026. Retiree scheme 2 yrs renewable. Citizenship rare.

SEN.note: Stable democracy; visa-free entry for many; residence via local paperwork.

XKX.note: Small, inexpensive; residence mostly via local company or employment. Not universally recognised.

VUT.note: Assured-income residence accessible; land leasehold only (custom ownership). EU suspended visa-free for Vanuatu passports (CBI) 2024-25.

MNE.note: DN scheme framed to run to end-2026, extension unconfirmed. Property threshold raised late 2025. Citizenship 10 yrs, renunciation required.

ZAF.note: Remote-work visa operational 2025. 2025 Constitutional Court ruling ended automatic loss of citizenship. Crime and Home Affairs delays are hurdles.

CPV.note: Remote-work scheme limited to Europe/N. America/CPLP/ECOWAS nationals; stable democracy. PR after 5 yrs.

IDN.note: Bali enforcement task force & deportations rose 2025-26; working on tourist/social visas risky. Land via Hak Pakai only. Citizenship 5 yrs, no dual.

KWT.note: Restrictive; investor long-term residency (2026) only for KDIPA executives.

BOL.note: Full Mercosur member 2024; online DIGEMIG window. PR in ~2-3 yrs; citizenship 3 yrs. Political/economic volatility.

JAM.note: English-speaking; no dedicated retiree/nomad scheme; crime concerns.

RUS.note: War and sanctions; foreign NGOs labelled 'undesirable'. Simplified residence for those opposing 'Western values' since 2024.

BIH.note: Property ownership can ground temporary residence; complex entity-level admin. Citizenship 8 yrs; dual only by treaty.

DOM.note: Residence visa obtained at consulate first; temporary then PR after ~4-5 yrs; citizenship ~2 yrs after PR.

PRY.note: Law 6984/2022: temporary first, no income/deposit proof; PR renewable 10 yrs (visit every 3 yrs). Citizenship 3 yrs after PR.

TZA.note: Class C permits renewable but no path to PR; citizenship rare and no dual. Political space narrowed 2024-25.

UZB.note: 5-yr investor permits since Jun 2025; citizenship needs renunciation and Uzbek.

GTM.note: Pensionado/rentista residence reported as permanent from start; Oct 2025 reforms dropped guarantor rule. Citizenship 5 yrs.

PHL.note: Easy long tourist stays for ~157 nationalities. DN visa authorised (EO 86, 2025) but not issuing as of Aug 2026. SRRV = indefinite residence; foreigners can't own land.

GHA.note: Stable democracy; English; welcoming to diaspora. Land via leasehold (≤50 yrs) for non-citizens.

BLZ.note: English-speaking; PR possible after 1 yr continuous stay (≤14 days away). Citizenship 5 yrs. CARICOM full free movement for some members since 2024.

FJI.note: Retirement permit on assured income; volunteer permits common. Most land is customary (iTaukei) — leasehold only.

NPL.note: NGO volunteering needs government-approved project/non-tourist visa; working on tourist visa is illegal. No PR; naturalisation essentially closed.

KEN.note: Class N since Oct 2024 (income threshold sources conflict). Volunteering without permit is illegal. Citizenship 7 yrs; dual allowed.

STP.note: Tiny, peaceful; limited admin; residence permits obtainable locally.

MDA.note: EU candidate; residence obtainable via company or IT park. Citizenship 8 yrs; dual allowed.

JOR.note: Many international NGOs; residence needs sponsor. Citizenship very rare.

GUY.note: English-speaking; oil boom raising costs; land leases possible.

MKD.note: No enacted DN visa (sources conflict). Low costs; EU candidate. Citizenship 8 yrs; dual restricted.

ALB.note: Law 79/2021 created nomad & pensioner permits; low costs; EU candidate. Others get 90/180 visa-free. Citizenship 5 yrs; dual allowed.

NIC.note: Law 694 incentives repealed 2024; residence renewed yearly. Regime has closed ~3,500+ NGOs incl. church groups (2025-26); detention/entry-refusal risk.

UKR.note: Full-scale war; martial law and security risks rule out new communities.

BWA.note: Stable democracy but restrictive permits; land via lease.

RWA.note: Open visa policy and efficient e-services; tight political control of civil society.

TUN.note: Authoritarian turn since 2021; foreign NGOs scrutinised.

KHM.note: Indefinitely renewable E-class extensions for almost any nationality; 2026 enforcement of work permits for EB. Foreigners can't own land.

SRB.note: 2024 law: online single permit, up to 3-yr temporary residence; PR after 3 yrs. Many nationalities visa-free 30-90 days. No DN visa.

ETH.note: Conflicts in Amhara/Oromia; CSO law liberalised 2019 then re-tightened.

FSM.note: Customary land; foreigners can't own land.

SLV.note: PR possible after 1 yr as pensioner/rentista. Security improved under state of exception, but civil liberties curtailed.

KAZ.note: Neo Nomad visa 1 yr + 1. Citizenship requires renunciation.

MAR.note: No DN permit; self-funded residence card renewable yearly; 10-yr card after ~4 yrs. Association law requires approvals.

AZE.note: Authoritarian; foreign NGO activity heavily restricted.

NAM.note: Since Apr 2025 ~33 Western nationalities need visas (reciprocity). Volunteering requires a work permit applied for in Windhoek.

COM.note: Small island state; limited admin capacity.

TLS.note: Many NGOs and aid workers; residence via sponsor; ASEAN member from 2025.

HND.note: Files via local lawyer; modest fees (~$300). Crime high outside Bay Islands. Citizenship ~3 yrs after residence.

MNG.note: Long cold winters; residence via work, investment or NGO registration.

BEN.note: 2024 law offers citizenship to Afro-descendants; jihadist risk in north.

IRN.note: Closed to foreign-led communities; detention risk for Western nationals.

DZA.note: Restrictive visa regime; NGO law strict.

KIR.note: Remote atolls; climate threat; very limited routes.

ZMB.note: Peaceful, open visa policy since 2023; permits via Department of Immigration.

LAO.note: Rules poorly documented; NGO work needs registered INGO sponsor. Remote work on tourist visa is a grey area.

BLR.note: Authoritarian, sanctions; foreign NGOs heavily restricted.

UGA.note: Many NGOs and missions; permits obtainable online; anti-LGBT law (2023) and election tensions.

routes: Digital Nomad status (1 yr, renewable to 10)
KGZ.note: Nomad status online, no work permit needed for IT-type remote work; eligibility lists may limit nationalities.

MDG.note: Low cost; political instability; land via long lease.

SWZ.note: Absolute monarchy; Swazi Nation Land customary.

SLB.note: Customary land; unrest risk in Honiara.

IRQ.note: Security risks; Kurdistan Region more accessible for NGO staff.

EGY.note: Renewable residence for property owners and self-funded foreigners; NGO law restrictive.

LBR.note: Citizenship limited to people 'of Negro descent'; NGO presence strong.

VEN.note: Political and economic crisis; Mercosur membership suspended.

DJI.note: Small, hot, costly; residence via work.

PNG.note: Many missions; high security risk; customary land.

PAK.note: INGO registration tightly controlled; security concerns.

BGD.note: NGO staff visas via NGO Affairs Bureau; political volatility.

MOZ.note: Insurgency in Cabo Delgado; post-election unrest 2024-25.

CMR.note: Anglophone conflict and Boko Haram zones.

LSO.note: Small mountain kingdom; land not sold to foreigners.

COD.note: Conflict in the east; weak state.
